findings.title: Auto purge unlinks SQLite WAL files without checkpoint or connection coordination
findings.evidence: Lines 23-24 delete all *.db-shm and *.db-wal recursively from cwd. strict_reviewer.py:155 calls run_auto_purge before git add/commit; no SQLite checkpoint or exclusive ownership is checked.
findings.trigger: Strict reviewer or another caller runs purge while a database has committed WAL content not checkpointed into its main database.
findings.impact: Committed database contents can be lost or concurrent clients disrupted; WAL files are persistent transaction state rather than disposable caches.

findings.title: License gate treats conjunctive restrictive licenses as permissive alternatives
findings.evidence: The parser splits only OR, then any permissive substring anywhere suppresses the restrictive result at line 73.
findings.trigger: A dependency declares MIT AND GPL-3.0-only (or another conjunction containing permissive and restrictive licenses).
findings.impact: The commercial distribution gate accepts a license expression whose restrictive obligations remain mandatory.

findings.title: Example manifest occupies 128 bytes on the documented 64-bit targets
findings.evidence: repr(C, align(64)) fields place exergy_score at offset 44, insert two bytes before the 4-byte ebr_ticket at 48, then padding[14] ends at 66; size rounds to 128. validate_alignment asserts size==64 at line 38.
findings.trigger: Compile and use this example on macOS/Linux 64-bit targets with normal AtomicU32 alignment.
findings.impact: The advertised 64-byte layout is false and validate_alignment panics when called; copying the example breaks the stated ctypes/shared-memory layout.

findings.title: Stress harness reports success even when health transitions fail
findings.evidence: saw_degraded, saw_dead and recovered are printed but never asserted; final line unconditionally prints empirical success.
findings.trigger: The engine regresses to never enter Degraded/Dead or reset fails to restore Healthy while hash checks still pass.
findings.impact: The harness exits successfully and announces passed falsification despite the very health transitions it promises to verify failing.

findings.title: Polymeter selector has no effect on generated rhythm
findings.evidence: Dialog exposes fixed-bar polyrhythm versus continuous polymeter at line 60 and apply forwards mode at line 108, but generate_euclidean never reads mode and scales both patterns to BAR.
findings.trigger: Select Polimetro Continuo in the dialog.
findings.impact: Output remains identical to fixed-bar mode; the offered polymeter feature is absent.
